## C round 4: FAIL

A's round 4 does not pass as written. The video drift tolerances (RF4-1 and RF4-2) failed. Two items are blocked because the headless browser can't show them, and I found one new Medium bug.

This session picked up after the earlier C session's context restart. Only one thing has changed since that session: the working tree, which is still the same (HEAD `cc1e531`, 30 changed or new files, nothing newer than my gate run). So I didn't re-run the gates; their earlier results stand: tsc 0 errors, 654/654 tests, build OK, biome 0 errors, 4 protected file hashes OK.

What I finished this session:
- **R5-L5 (b), turning the loop off while it's playing:** passed in 3 of 3 runs. The music picks up exactly where it was (0 s jump), only one music source plays at a time, and the next scheduled loop pass is cancelled before it sounds.
- **R5-L5 (c), dragging the loop brace while playing:** passed in 3 of 3 runs. Each run re-anchored 3 times with a 0 s jump, then wrapped from 5 back to 3. The drag is one Undo entry.
- **C-R4-02 scope, tested in the browser:**
  - Clips (music and video) and the loop brace get stuck.
  - The playhead ruler and lane box-selection recover correctly.
  - The cause is in the clip and brace code: a second touch replaces the first gesture without releasing it. This happens whether or not the browser captures the pointer.
  - The counting code is already correct and tested, so the fix belongs in `ArrangementClip` and `ArrangementLoopBrace`. The ruler already does it the right way and can be the model.

## Bugs for B
| ID | Severity | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| C-R4-01 | Medium | Video drifts too far from the audio on a busy machine. Same-load runs passed 9/10 (after the 2 allowed re-runs), runs after a reload passed 2/5, loop runs passed 4/5. Every failure is the video lagging, and most coincide with browser stalls. The worst case is the first Play after a fresh load: the video took 1.7 s to catch up. The other D-19 sync rules held in every run. |
| C-R4-02 | Medium | Two pointers pressed on the same clip or brace leave the Studio thinking a drag is still going. After that, Undo, Redo and editing stay blocked until a page reload, which loses the demo arrangement. |
| C-R4-03 | Low | Collection names in the library are cut off, so the synthetic and public collections look the same. |
| C-R4-04 | Low | Waveform previews for the synthetic stems are nearly flat (bars reach at most 7 of 32 px). |

32 acceptance items passed. Anonymous access does not get past premium auth: without sign-in, the Studio token request returns 401 and `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required". Exported WAVs match the expected mix to within 9e-8.

## Needs the Tech Lead with a real mouse in Windows Chrome
- **R23-1:** the scrollbar styling, which headless Chrome hides.
- **R23-2:** mouse wheel, trackpad and scrollbar thumb dragging.
- **R12-L4:** dragging a sound from the library onto a lane with a real mouse.
- **C-R4-01:** a re-measure of video drift on a quiet machine, before B decides between fixing the code and blaming the environment.
- **RF4-3:** one spec conflict for B to fix in the wording (`play()` may start up to 20 ms early, but another line says the video stays paused until the start time).

Still open from the root review and publication checkpoint:
- **M3:** doc 012 doesn't match what was actually verified.
- **L6:** the export dialog's "same graph as playback" wording during a loop.
- **High:** purchased Studio pages always build stem URLs from `middle-east`.
- **Medium:**
  - Category matching doesn't handle extra spaces.
  - The user ID hash differs between Studio and downloads.
  - `AGENTS.md` and `.codex` point to paths that don't exist.
- **Backlog not started:** SRW-07..10, 11B, 13..20 and T12.

I didn't touch app source, commit or deploy. Several connected services (Atlassian, Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, Microsoft 365, Similarweb, Klaviyo, Amplitude and Slack plugins) need authorizing in claude.ai connector settings or `/mcp` before they can be used.

Files are in `C:\Apps\czaba-project\tmp\studio-real-loop\`:
- c-round-4.md
- c-round-4.json
- c-round-4\ (screenshots, scripts and run data)
